name: What should I look for when hiring a contractor for vinyl siding replacement?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when hiring a contractor for vinyl siding replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: When hiring a contractor, look for one with proper licensing and insurance, specific experience in vinyl siding replacement, and a strong local reputation. Request references and review their portfolio of completed projects. Ensure they provide a detailed, written estimate outlining all costs, materials, and project timelines. Clear communication and a comprehensive warranty are also important considerations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for licensed, insured, and experienced contractors with good references, a detailed estimate, and clear communication.
